entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Francisco Viti was an Angolan Roman Catholic prelate. He was bishop of Menongue from 1975 to 1986 and archbishop of Huambo from 1986 to 2003. Viti was born on 15 August 1933, and died on 15 April 2023, at the age of 89.
